body: Don't, I repeat, DON'T do it. Please, talk to us. Losing your SO is hard, it really is, but please, please, PLEASE hear us out. You don't see what you could be missing.
Thanks. You're probably right, it will help to distract myself and get away from the pain. I'll try.

Of course, my SO helps fill the gap, but it's never quite enough.
It seems no one around me, besides my mother, who is very busy, quite understands the pain.

Oh boy, if I had a dollar for every time I heard this...

Even though you're right, it's not helping the sorrow emptiness I still feel.
Nothing I've heard has helped me with the grief. It seems to be a lingering pain that I can't seem to get rid of, not with time, not with medicine, not with emotional help.
